name: book-reader-studio
description: Local-first PDF & EPUB Book Reader Studio with RTL/LTR typography, dual-mode & reflowable highlighting, bookmarks, smart TOC, and Obsidian Markdown export (macOS, Windows, Android).
author: Ketabkhan Studio

scripts.build:mac: node scripts/build-web.mjs && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dmg zip --publish never
scripts.build:win: node scripts/build-web.mjs && electron-builder --win nsis portable --publish never
scripts.cap:sync: node scripts/build-web.mjs && npx cap sync android
